title: Hanuman Gada As Mace
description: This Resource Pack Changes Mace Texture With Gada , The Weapon of Lord Hanuman From Hindu Mythology
body:
Bring a touch of Hindu mythology to Minecraft with this simple resource pack that replaces the Mace texture with Lord Hanuman's Gada, the iconic weapon carried by one of the most revered figures in Hindu tradition. The pack only changes the weapon's appearance, allowing you to enjoy the familiar Mace mechanics while wielding a legendary and culturally inspired design.

Features:

Replaces the Mace texture with Hanuman's Gada
Keeps all original Mace functionality and animations
Lightweight and easy to install
Compatible with any modpack that includes the Mace

Perfect for players who want to add a mythological and spiritual aesthetic to their Minecraft adventures.
